hero.headline: Turn Local Exploration Into a Game
hero.subtext: Discover hidden gems, check in, earn rewards — and support the local businesses that make Puerto Rico great.

whyZutto.title: Why Zutto?
whyZutto.subtitle: Two sides of the same problem — and one platform that fixes both.
whyZutto.userHeadline: For people who want to support local
whyZutto.userDescription: You know local businesses matter, but finding where to go, what they offer, and why it's worth it is hard. Interest fades. Habits stick to the familiar.
whyZutto.businessHeadline: For businesses that deserve more customers
whyZutto.businessDescription: 24% of Puerto Rico small businesses struggle to attract and retain customers — even when they're doing everything right. They're invisible in a world dominated by large platforms.
whyZutto.businessPain: Visibility is broken for local businesses.
whyZutto.statLabel: of Puerto Rico SMBs struggle to attract customers

howItWorks.title: How Zutto Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to start exploring, earning, and supporting local.

step1.title: Discover
step1.description: Use Zutto Radar to find exactly what you're craving — from a specific coffee order to a live music night — nearby, with prices and details.

step2.title: Check In
step2.description: Scan the QR code when you arrive, earn points instantly, and build your streak. Every visit counts.

step3.title: Earn & Explore
step3.description: Complete challenges, unlock rewards, and discover new local favorites — all while helping your community thrive.

radarSpotlight.title: Search for exactly what you want
radarSpotlight.description: Not just "coffee near me" — Zutto Radar lets you search for a matcha cold brew with oat milk and shows you which local café makes it, the price, the distance, and how to get there.
radarSpotlight.example: Want a matcha cold brew with oat milk?

challenges.title: Make exploration a game
challenges.subtitle: Complete daily and weekly challenges to earn bonus points, unlock badges, and keep your local adventure going.

example2.title: History Buff
example2.description: Explore a historic site this weekend

example3.title: Adventurous Palate
example3.description: Try something new at your favorite café

example4.title: Night Out
example4.description: Catch live music at a local venue

businessDashboard.title: Real data. Real insights. Real growth.
businessDashboard.subtitle: Stop guessing. Zutto gives you the customer intelligence you need to make smarter business decisions — without paid ads.

feature1.title: Know your visitors
feature1.description: See who's visiting — new customers vs. returning regulars — and understand what keeps them coming back.

feature2.title: Peak hour intelligence
feature2.description: Know exactly when your peak hours are and what drives customers through the door at those times.

feature3.title: Product & service tracking
feature3.description: Track which specific products or services generate the most engagement and repeat visits.

feature4.title: Behavior beyond your walls
feature4.description: Understand where your customers go before and after visiting you — complete neighborhood context.

feature5.title: Compete on data, not ads
feature5.description: Level the playing field. Use real customer insights to outperform bigger competitors without big budgets.
